checks.a_analysis: I reviewed the converted document for any duplicated text blocks or sections. The term 'State Auditor' appears twice in the source (once in the letterhead on page 1 and once in the signature block on page 2) and is correctly represented twice in the output. No other paragraphs or data points are repeated in the JSON.

The heading hierarchy in the output is broken. The document lacks an H1 heading entirely. The first heading element, 'Office of the State Auditor', is incorrectly assigned to level 2 (H2). Screen readers and standard structural hierarchy require an H1 to be the top-level heading for the document title or main subject before proceeding to H2 for subsections.

The multi-part header is processed top-to-bottom and left-to-right (Seal, Name/Title, Main Header, Address/Contact), followed by the recipient block, subject line, body text, and finally the signature block. The omission of the repetitive page 2 header is an expected artifact of the conversion process for accessibility.
The document does not contain explicit numbered or bulleted lists. Lists embedded within paragraphs (such as audit procedures) are correctly preserved as part of the paragraph blocks.

The URLs provided in the source ('http://www.ncauditor.net' and 'www.ncauditor.net') are correctly captured as functional links in the output. The href attributes accurately reflect the URLs, including the addition of https to the second instance.
